name: code_findings
description: Source code research findings. Write full evidence (file paths, line numbers, github.netflix.net URLs) to a findings file; return a small structured confirmation. Never put raw evidence content in the coms message itself.

findings_file.description: Absolute path to the findings file containing all claims and evidence

claim_count.description: Number of verified claims written to the findings file

repos_cloned.description: New repos cloned during this task, format: 'service-key: ~/code/nflx/repo'

open_questions.description: Questions that could not be resolved with available tools
